title: Maximum Value of a String
approach: Treat digit-only strings as integers and other strings by length
statement: Treat digit-only strings as integers and other strings by length.
explanation: For each string, use its numeric value if every character is a digit; otherwise use its length, then take the maximum.

title: Delete Greatest Value in Each Row
approach: Sort rows and sum the maximum remaining value at each column
statement: Sort rows and sum the maximum remaining value at each column.
explanation: Sort every row ascending; at each column position, add the maximum value across rows.

title: Count Pairs Of Similar Strings
approach: Count pairs whose words have the same set of letters
statement: Count pairs whose words have the same set of letters.
explanation: Convert each word to a set of distinct letters and count pairs of equal sets.

title: Maximum Enemy Forts That Can Be Captured
approach: Count zeros between consecutive opposite nonzero forts
statement: Count zeros between consecutive opposite nonzero forts.
explanation: Track the previous nonzero fort; when the next nonzero fort has the opposite sign, the intervening zeros can be captured.

title: Count the Digits That Divide a Number
approach: Check each digit as a divisor
statement: Check each digit as a divisor.
explanation: Inspect each decimal digit and count those that divide the original number evenly.

title: Maximum Count of Positive Integer and Negative Integer
approach: Count negative and positive elements and take the larger count
statement: Count negative and positive elements and take the larger count.
explanation: Count values below zero and above zero separately; zeros contribute to neither count.

title: Difference Between Element Sum and Digit Sum of an Array
approach: Subtract the total digit sum from the element sum
statement: Subtract the total digit sum from the element sum.
explanation: Compute the sum of all numbers and the sum of their decimal digits, then return the absolute difference.

title: Minimum Common Value
approach: Find the first shared value in sorted arrays
statement: Find the first shared value in sorted arrays.
explanation: Use two pointers to advance the smaller current value; the first match is the minimum common value.

title: Alternating Digit Sum
approach: Add and subtract digits alternately from left to right
statement: Add and subtract digits alternately from left to right.
explanation: Traverse the digits from most significant to least significant, alternating plus and minus signs.

title: Separate the Digits in an Array
approach: Append each number's digits in original order
statement: Append each number's digits in original order.
explanation: Convert each integer to its decimal digits and concatenate them in array order.
